Below slot B are two bays for the DC power supply filters (an optional safety panel covers both). Rear: the vertical air filter tray at the left, the single Enhanced Fan Tray beside it and two horizontal DC PEM-3 bays at the bottom. Air enters at the right side and leaves at the rear. Every card is authored horizontal and seated at rotate 0, MDA slot 1 at the left as the guide says.","format":1,"gaps":[{"note":"Every figure used is vendor line art and no SR-7 photograph is staged, so colour and finish are estimated from the SR-12 in the owner's lab. IOM5-e needs fabric-speed-c, which means the -B chassis 3HE10766AA with SFM6-7/12 (SR-7 guide p61-64); IOM3-XP and other FP2 cards fail at fabric-speed-b and -c. Empty slots take an impedance panel.","index-origin":1,"role":"traffic","term":"Slot"},"fans":{"description":"the single Enhanced Fan Tray at the rear, right of the air filter tray (p48)","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Fan Tray"},"grounding":{"description":"the front ESD plug receptacle at the bottom of the slot-number strip","index-origin":1,"role":"furniture","term":"Point"},"pems":{"attrs":{"redundancy":"1+1","redundancy-note":"SR-7 guide p72: one DC PEM-3 can support the full system current requirements without power redundancy; for redundancy two must be installed and powered on at all times"},"description":"two horizontal DC PEM-3 bays along the bottom of the rear, PEM 1 at the LEFT as seen from behind (p51 keys 4 and 5)","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"PEM"},"power-filters":{"attrs":{"redundancy":"1+1","redundancy-note":"SR-7 guide p72: each power supply filter feeds its own PEM-3, and one PEM-3 carries the full system while two give redundancy; the filters follow their PEMs"},"description":"the two DC power supply filter bays below slot B, 1 at the left (p48); each filter is wired internally to its own rear PEM-3 (p72 Figure 12)","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Filter Bay"},"sfm-slots":{"description":"the two bottom module slots A (rel-pos 1) and B (rel-pos 2) for the switch fabric / control processor: SFM5-7 + CPM5, SFM6-7/12 + CPM5, or the integrated SF/CPM3-7 / SF/CPM4-7. One is required; two give redundancy, and in a redundant system the two SF/CPMs must be of the same type (p48). DC only: -40 to -72 VDC into two load-sharing PEM-3s, each with one -48 V / RTN terminal pair behind a cover and a 100 A breaker; one PEM carries the full system, two give redundancy (p72). PEM-3 100A: 4000 W at -40 to -72 V, 4600 W at -46 to -72 V (p95 Table 31). Each PEM-3 connects internally to its own front power supply filter (p72 Figure 12).
